detail.longDescription:
The makers of Football Superstar and Football Owner 2 proudly present our new game... Superstar Football Agent.

The aim is simple... start at the bottom and wheel and deal your way to become the most powerful football agent in the world.

• Search the globe for players and sign them up to your agency.
• Use your mobile to contact and speak to players.  Perhaps offering some cash will entice them to your agency?
• Negotiate transfers and contracts but make sure you get your cut!
• Improve your abilities so you can attract the biggest names!
• Buy luxury items to promote your image.
• Hire staff to help develop players, find endorsements and more!
• Monitor player performance and earning power. Keep the most profitable clients, ditch the rest!
• Manage your finances as you see fit!
• Work in different countries so there's always a transfer window open somewhere.
• In-game data editor.
• Here at Lazy Boy we enjoy playing games, not watching ads, so no ads!

Can you represent the worlds best players?

Prove it…
